outcome: A payroll operator sees where a payroll run stands, runs combine, match and aggregate, confirms the HR snapshot, and sees what was published, live
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4601` (mock) shows two input rows with provider, rows (142 and 139), checks ("2 held" and "Passed"), the finding line and a "Run combine" button, and no station strip, no STATE column, no decision card — verify: open the page; e2e asserts absence.
`/work/4602` shows a Combined block "Complete" with total 140 and held 2, and "Not recorded" (never 0) for matched and unmatched — verify: page text; unit test on the mapper with `matched:null`.
`/work/4603` shows "Matching can't start." with a "Confirm I received it" button and "Run match" off; with two proofs the person must choose one first — verify: page; e2e.

Pressing "Confirm I received it" sends exactly one `POST /work/4603/payroll-operations` with `{action:"receive_hr", expected_revision, case_revision, snapshot_id:303, evidence_id:77}`, then re-reads, and the page shows "Received" only from the re-read — verify: network panel and mock request log.
`/work/4604` shows Matched 136, Unmatched 2, Conflict 1, Held 2 and no "paid after leaving" reason — verify: page; e2e.

Pressing "Run combine" on 4601 sends one `POST` with `{action:"working", stage:"combine", expected_revision, case_revision}` and no other fields; the next read shows the Combined block — verify: network panel; unit test on the body.
A body never contains a `null` or `0` token: with the read not loaded every control is off and nothing is sent — verify: unit test.
A write that gets 409 (`4611`) re-reads, shows "This changed while you were working. Showing the latest version.", and sends nothing again by itself — verify: mock scenario; count requests.

A dropped connection after a write, or `/work/4612` (`effect_uncertain`), locks every station button with "We couldn't confirm that this ran. Check the page before trying again." and sends no request until the re-read shows a new `expected_revision` and a settled state — verify: mock scenario; request count.

`/work/4605` shows "NGN 99,200,000.00" as the eligible total from `eligible_total` "99200000.00" through `Money`, the four business-unit rows, "Version 1", "Your receipt: None", and no "Unknown" split, no staff counts and no per-recipient rows — verify: page; e2e.

A business unit absent from `by_business_unit` has no row and no 0; an absent `eligible_total` cannot occur by contract, but a report 403 shows "The totals aren't available to you." and the rest of the panel still draws — verify: unit test; mock 403 on the report.
`/work/4606` shows the verified tag and the report block and does not show "Receipts 2 of 2", "Written to HR records" or "Posted to the ledger" — verify: e2e asserts absence.
`/work/4607` shows "Totals version 1 were withdrawn" with the date and "Receipt recorded" with the received time, and no "Start a corrected run" button — verify: page; e2e.
`previous_receipt` with null `receipt_id` and null `received_at` reads "No receipt was recorded." and "Not recorded" — verify: unit test.

`/work/4609` (404) and `/work/4610` (403) both show exactly "This record is unavailable." with no staff names, values or ids; neither shows a reason — verify: open both and compare text; unit test on the mapper.
A 403 `csrf_failed` on a write does not show the no-access state; it refreshes the session once and says "Press the button again"; no automatic second send — verify: unit test counts fetch calls.

A different signed-in user without the payroll grant, and a different tenant's work id, each get the no-access state and no `working-rows` or report call is made after the first denied read — verify: mock scenarios; request log; live check with two accounts against Django 8030.

No `rows[]` value from `working-rows` (employee, amount, bu, row_ref, sources) appears in the DOM, in `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`, in a URL, in a React Query or cache key, or in any `console` output — verify: unit test greps the mapper output; e2e dumps storage and the DOM and searches fixture employee names.

Against live Django 8030, for a real payroll work id the page shows the same `stage`, `finding`, `working[]` counts and `hr_receipt` state as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/payroll-operations` — verify: compare with the `oa.py live` output or `curl` JSON using the session.
Against live Django, a run with a publication shows the same `eligible_total`, `by_business_unit` and `version` as `GET .../payroll/reports/{publication_id}` — verify: compare with the `curl` JSON.

The page makes no `POST /work/{id}/reviews`, `aggregate-receipt`, `corrections`, or `payroll-operations` with `publish`, `withdraw`, `successor` or `restart`, and shows no Publish, Withdraw, Approve, Return, Ask HR or Start-a-corrected-run control — verify: grep `liveApi.POST` in `src/features/payroll-run` shows only `working`, `receive_hr` and `startPayrollRun`; e2e asserts absence.

`startPayrollRun` sends `finance-payroll/v1` with `idempotency_key` and the two input ids, and `hr_snapshot_id` null stays `null` — verify: unit test against the mock; it is not imported by any page (grep).
An unknown `working[].codes` value and an unknown `stage` draw their raw text; a missing selected input in Read 3 draws "Input {n}" — verify: unit tests.
A failed Read 2 or Read 3 leaves the other blocks drawn and shows that block's error with Try again; a failed re-read after a write keeps the last good read — verify: mock scenarios.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: the page matches the SCR-59 boards for the parts that remain; hidden parts leave no empty gap or empty heading — verify: screenshots at both widths reviewed against the SCR-59 desktop and mobile boards.

Tests exist for the mapper (all seven states), the two write bodies, the uncertain lock, the 409 path and the no-leak rule in criterion 18; `delivery/checks.sh` passes — verify: `npm test`; checks result.

risk.rationale: High. This is restricted payroll data, with identity-bound access per record (`working-rows`, snapshot rows) and the run that feeds the published pay aggregate for a named recipient. Writes in part 1 (combine, match, aggregate, receive_hr) are hard to undo and need operation keys and evidence ids. The surfaces are ui, api, security, auth, payments and product-decision (new flow and wording the client must see). The effect_uncertain and awaiting_reconciliation states must reconcile before any retry.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
